Maria: Morning — travel hiccup, need someone to take my oncall early Sunday 06:00-12:00 PST. I can cover until 08:00 then my phone will be off. Non-incident; mostly handoff + prewarm. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/oncall-image-gen

Sam: Quick Q — is this Hosted or Dedicated? Any pinned model/version we should prewarm?

Maria: Hosted (us-west1). Route is /v1/generate-img pinned to model `img-clarity-v2` (stable). No extra creds needed — use service account `red-ops` which is already in the runbook. Prewarm I use (run ~10s before shift):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/serve/prewarm" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"img-clarity-v2","concurrency":2,"seq_len":512}'
```
This warms KV cache and a small batch to spin up kernels. Expect ~30s for GPU kernel load.

Jordan: I can take 06:00-10:00. @Sam you good to grab 10:00-12:00?

Sam: Yep I can pick up 10:00-12:00, @Maria marked. I can also prewarm again at 09:50 before I start.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded — Jordan assigned 06:00-10:00, Sam assigned 10:00-12:00. Rota: https://rota.redwood.internal/eng-oncall/2024/week-29

Maria: :thumbsup: Thanks both. A couple quick FYI: if concurrency >2 you might see GPU OOMs on node type g4dn-xlarge, keep concurrency at 2 unless you escalate to Dedicated. Logs are under /services/image-gen/logs (elk). If error rate spikes >5% or tail latency >2s, escalate to eng-oncall and open a debug issue.

Jordan: Got it. I'll prewarm at 05:50 and leave a handoff note in the runbook with prewarm output.

Sam: Thanks — safe travels Maria!
